content: अपौरुष, -पौरुषेय {%a.%} .²1 Unmanly, cowardly, timid. .²2 Superhuman, not of the authorship of man, of divine origin; अपौरुषेया वेदाः; अपौरुषेयप्रतिष्ठः सुवर्णबिन्दुरित्याख्यायते <ls>Māl. 9</ls> not set up by (the hand of) man. .{@-षम्, -षेयम्@} .²1 Cowardice, pusillanimity. .²2 Superhuman power.
